coverImageAlt: A navy cabinet sorts blank paper pieces into open planning trays beside an empty tray and orange unresolved piece.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: A compact cabinet of planning trays that gathers uncertain source pieces and organizes them into a concise, traceable product requirements set, expressing a disciplined clarify-then-draft workflow.
Scene/backdrop: Minimal warm-paper workshop wall against deep slate, with no office furniture, labels, or screens.
Subject: One dominant navy tabletop cabinet in oblique view with several differently sized open trays; blank warm-paper shapes are sorted into the trays, cyan rails connect the levels, and one orange unresolved piece waits beside a deliberately empty tray.
Style/medium: premium editorial illustration with tactile dimensional detail; miniature cabinetmaking, linen-lined trays, thick paper pieces, and restrained handcrafted realism.
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; oblique three-quarter view with a compact stepped silhouette distinct from the other PRD covers; crop-safe focal subject; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width; no essential detail in the outer 8%.
Lighting/mood: calm, capable, quietly technical; soft cyan shelf light and a sparing orange unresolved piece.
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027.
Materials/textures: matte painted wood, linen tray lining, deckled paper pieces, brushed metal rails.
Constraints: original image; coherent PRD-template family yet unmistakably distinct through a cabinet-and-trays silhouette; every paper piece and tray face completely blank; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling.
Avoid: filing-cabinet labels, interface panels, document thumbnails, office stock imagery, generic chatbot imagery, glowing brains, Microsoft-like gradients.
Targeted correction: Pull the camera back slightly so the cabinet top, every open tray, the empty tray, and the orange unresolved paper piece all fit inside the inner 84% with a visible border; place the orange piece immediately beside the empty tray rather than near an image edge, and keep every surface completely blank.
